name: Gathering Together
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of believers gathering together to hear God's Word, learn His commands, and foster reverence for Him, as seen in Deuteronomy 31:12. The Psalms call for the assembly of God's covenant people, highlighting the sacredness of such unity. Jesus teaches that gathering in His name invites His presence among believers (Matthew 18:20) and underscores the spiritual division between those who gather with Him and those who do not (Matthew 12:30). The early church exemplified this unity by coming together with one accord, as at Pentecost (Acts 2:1). Believers are also warned to remain vigilant and not be distracted by worldly cares that could hinder their readiness for the Lord (Luke 21:34).
